basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast who recently got into gaming and Reddit. I live in Austin, Texas, and work as a junior IT support specialist. I enjoy exploring new tech and gaming trends, though I often find myself overwhelmed by the sheer amount of information out there. I love animals, particularly dogs, and I spend a lot of my free time playing video games or watching tech reviews on YouTube. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7-11 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in tech is primarily self-taught, fueled by a curiosity to understand how things work. I have a basic understanding of computer hardware and software acquired from various online courses and tutorials. My gaming knowledge is still growing as I'm new to the scene.
